# Astronomical 0.2.83
## Raw Hugging Face Qwen3.5 checkpoints now serve correctly
Checkpoints in the newer unified Hugging Face layout (such as `empero-ai/Qwen3.8-2B-Distill`) previously loaded but produced degenerate single-token output. Astronomical now normalizes unified tensor names to the canonical executable names at load and materializes RMSNorm weights stored as `gamma - 1` exactly once at binding, restoring token-for-token parity with the reference implementation in both answer and thinking modes. MLX-converted checkpoints keep byte-identical behavior.
## Thin Talk usability
The web client gained a sticky reasoning disclosure, a model picker, canvas zoom, scoped answer copying, gated transcript re-renders, and attachment thumbnail trust checks. Thin Talk web tests now run in continuous integration.
## Download catalog
Added the Ternary Bonsai 2 27B DFlash2 MLX model documentation entry.
## Quality and maintainability
Repository organization by concern across the CLI, daemon, and inference worker crates; strict clippy cleanliness across all model-serving targets including the `direct-mlx` acceptance lane; a new `audit-test-declarations` xtask subcommand that catches orphaned test files; and a rustfmt continuous-integration lane.
## Compatibility
No configuration changes: existing configuration files and installed models keep working as before, and upgrading preserves all user state.
This release is distributed as a signed and notarized DMG. The Sparkle update feed and its signatures cover the exact published bytes.
